capabilities.title: Declarative agent orchestration: define multi-agent pipelines in composable YAML/JSON configs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Symphony: OpenAI's composable multi-agent orchestration framework
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses lib/agent.ts for single-agent coordination; a declarative multi-agent pipeline config format is not yet implemented.

capabilities.title: Typed handoff contracts between agents: typed input/output schemas enforced at agent boundaries
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Symphony: typed agent interfaces for safe inter-agent handoffs
capabilities.reason: Nexus agent handoffs are prose-based; typed input/output schemas at agent boundaries not yet enforced.

capabilities.title: Parallel agent execution: run multiple agents concurrently with synchronized result merging
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents run serially; parallel execution with synchronized result merging is pending.

capabilities.title: Shared memory between agents in a pipeline: read/write to a common context store
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Symphony: pipeline-scoped shared memory for agent coordination
capabilities.reason: Nexus agents have isolated memory; cross-agent shared context store not yet implemented.

capabilities.title: Cloud-only OpenAI API runtime for agent execution
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Symphony: designed around OpenAI API for LLM calls
capabilities.reason: Nexus is free/local-first with BYOK; all AI calls go through lib/ai.ts supporting multiple providers including Ollama. OpenAI-locked runtime excluded.
